pages.d: A web UI for AI agents in Python. Streaming chat, an artifacts canvas, selectable layouts, a dashboard and docs sites, from one pip package.

s.x: Python 3.10 or higher. Open . The app opens in the React app shell, in its chat layout. Connect a model with aiui.stream_token() in the quick start, or open the canvas with AIUI_LAYOUT=chat-canvas aiui run app.py.

Stream replies, tool calls and approvals from the agent you already have. The app shell, the chat, the dashboard and the other styles, side by side. Five frames for the same app, and the canvas the agent's work opens in. Add pages, settings and themes from a Python package. A folder of Markdown becomes a site like this one. Behind a proxy, with auth on every route and WebSocket. Looking something up? The CLI, the Python API and the YAML configuration cover every command, function and key. PraisonAIUI is MIT licensed. Install it from PyPI as aiui; the import name is praisonaiui and the command is aiui.

s.x: PraisonAIUI is one Python package. The PyPI name is aiui, you import it as praisonaiui, and the command is aiui. The browser UI ships inside the wheel, so you do not need Node.js or npm to run an app or build a docs site.
Python 3.10 or higher. The browser UI ships inside the wheel. You need Node.js only to change the React frontend in a clone of the repository (version in src/frontend/.nvmrc).
pip uv pipx Check the install: A version number means the aiui command is on your path. Next: the quick start. The wheel installs two commands that do the same thing: aiui and praisonaiui.

The base install runs the server, the chat UI and aiui build. Extras add integrations. Install one with pip install "aiui[ ]". Extra Adds praisonai PraisonAI Agents, the PraisonAI wrapper, gateway and bot dependencies, for --backend praisonai. A YAML chat app (aiui run chat.yaml) needs only pip install praisonaiagents memory ChromaDB and LiteLLM for agent memory knowledge mem0, ChromaDB, MarkItDown and Chonkie for the knowledge base graph mem0 graph memory sql SQLAlchemy (async) and aiosqlite for SQLAlchemyDataStore postgres sql plus asyncpg bot Telegram, Discord and Slack bot libraries slack, discord, teams One channel's SDK only mcp The MCP client SDK a2ui PraisonAI Agents with A2UI support (agent canvas) langchain, llama-index, semantic-kernel Framework integrations all Every extra above dev pytest, ruff, mypy and the test dependencies (for contributors) The list is [project.optional-dependencies] in pyproject.toml.

Nothing in this repository is published to npm for the current UI: src/frontend/package.json is private and its build is committed into the Python package. Plugins for the React app shell import @aiui/sdk, which the shell provides at runtime; see UI plugins. The older praisonaiui package on npm (0.1.0) is a separate docs-site runtime, described under TypeScript SDK; aiui run and aiui build do not use it.
To work on PraisonAIUI itself: See Testing for the test commands.

s.x: Run a chat app, connect it to a model, then try the other UI styles and layouts.
Python 3.10 or higher:

Create app.py: Run it: Open http://127.0.0.1:8000 and send a message. If port 8000 is taken, aiui run picks the next free port and prints the URL it used. An app that only has a @aiui.reply callback opens in the React app shell (style: app) in its chat layout: the chat, with your conversations and the other pages in the sidebar. The same app is examples/python/01-chat.

Stream tokens from any client library with aiui.stream_token(). With OpenAI (pip install openai), set your key first: Then open a new terminal. aiui run also reads a .env file in the current folder (and ~/.praisonai/.env) without overriding variables already set. examples/python/03-chat-with-ai adds conversation history, a welcome message and starters.

s.x: The app shell has selectable layouts. Pick one per run with AIUI_LAYOUT, or in the app with aiui.set_layout(): See React app shell and Layouts for every layout.

Register a page with @aiui.page. An app with pages opens in the dashboard style, with your page in the sidebar next to the built-in ones: How the style is chosen: --style on the command line wins, then aiui.set_style() in the app. Without either, aiui run looks at the callbacks: @aiui.page gives dashboard, @aiui.profiles plus registered agents gives agents, and anything else the app shell. See UI Styles.
A YAML file can define the agent without Python. It runs on PraisonAI Agents, so install that first: pip install praisonaiagents (or the full pip install "aiui[praisonai]"), and set OPENAI_API_KEY.
aiui build turns a folder of Markdown into a static site: Open http://127.0.0.1:8000/docs/. To publish it, see Deploy to GitHub Pages.
Never paste an API key into app.py or aiui.yaml: read it from the environment, as above. With the server running, in another terminal:
The commands you will use most. Decorators, message functions and the set_* setters. Everything the YAML file can say.

pages.d: The commands you will use most. Every command and option is in the

s.x: The commands you will use most. Every command and option is in the CLI Reference; aiui --help prints the same from the installed version.
Without --style, the style comes from aiui.set_style() or is detected from the callbacks; a plain chat app opens the React app shell in its chat layout. See UI Styles.
See Deploy to GitHub Pages to publish the build.
aiui test defaults to http://127.0.0.1:8082, so pass --server for a server on another port. See API Testing.

Management commands call the server's HTTP API. They default to http://127.0.0.1:8000; pass --server URL for another one. The full list (sessions, session-ext, memory, provider, features, pages, config, approval, schedule, skills, hooks, workflows, eval, traces, surface, plugins) is in the CLI Reference.

s.x: Docs-site configurations beyond a single template. Every snippet here passes aiui validate --strict.
A centered landing page with a hero banner, and the three-column layout for the docs: The layouts and the zones each renders are in Templates and Widget Zones.
A route's slots can override the right slot (the table of contents); header and footer always come from the template. The first matching route wins, so put the specific route first:

The docs site renderer has no hook for your own header or sidebar component; the Header and Footer props cover branding (see Slots & Components). For full control, scaffold the React frontend with aiui init --frontend and change it there.
site.customCss applies to both the runtime server (aiui run, CSS text) and the static docs output of aiui build (CSS text, files and URLs); see Theming.

s.x: The model fallback feature (praisonaiui.features.model_fallback) lists the available models and stores an ordered fallback chain that the UI can show and edit. The chain is stored, not applied Nothing in PraisonAIUI reads the chain when it sends a request: the provider still calls the agent's own model, and a failed call is not retried on the next model. The chain is also kept in memory only, so a restart clears it. Use it as a setting your own provider or @aiui.reply callback reads (see below).
The model list comes from litellm.model_list when LiteLLM is installed and has models configured. Otherwise it is a short static list: gpt-4o, gpt-4o-mini, claude-3-5-sonnet and gemini-2.0-flash.
Use the server's shared manager, not a new ModelFallbackManager(), so you see what the API set:
Endpoint Method Description /api/models GET Available models and the current fallback chain /api/models/fallback PUT Set the chain ({"models": [...]}; 400 if not a list)
Providers: LLM provider configuration

pages.d: Synthesize speech from text using swappable backends — browser-native (zero cost) or OpenAI TTS API.

s.x: Synthesize speech from text using swappable backends — browser-native (zero cost) or OpenAI TTS API.

Default: BrowserTTSManager — uses the browser's built-in Web Speech API, requires no API key, runs entirely client-side. Optional: OpenAITTSManager — uses OpenAI's TTS API for higher-quality voices (alloy, echo, fable, onyx, nova, shimmer). Requires openai package and API key.
Endpoint Method Description /api/tts/voices GET List available voices /api/tts/synthesize POST Synthesize speech from text
Gateway Chat — Chat can use TTS for voice responses

pages.d: Enable and customize dark mode for your site.

s.x: Enable and customize dark mode for your site.
Enable dark mode in your configuration:

When darkMode: true, the runtime: Checks user's system preference (prefers-color-scheme) Adds a toggle button to the Header component Persists user preference in localStorage Applies data-theme="dark" to the HTML element

The React styles served by aiui run (chat, the default, plus agents, playground) and the app shell (style: app) pick the colour mode in this order: the viewer's choice, stored under aiui-theme-preference (light, dark or system); the app's: aiui.set_theme(dark_mode=True|False), else YAML site.theme.mode (light, dark, system) or site.theme.darkMode; the OS (prefers-color-scheme) when neither chose one. The page follows the OS when it changes. A static aiui build site has no server to report the app's choice, so it uses site.theme.darkMode (dark by default) unless the viewer picked a mode. With site.theme.strict: true a built site has no theme toggle and ignores the viewer's stored choice (Branding).
